entities.name: Rith
entities.description: One of the five Primeval Dragons of Dominaria, a green dragon, daughter of Palladia-Mors and sister of Darigaaz.

entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: Rith's brother, whose mind she dominated; reincarnated.

entities.name: Fall of the Primevals
entities.description: The event during which Rith was imprisoned.

entities.name: Nemata
entities.description: A Magnigoth Treefolk in Yavimaya in which Rith was imprisoned by the green Numena.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Land where Rith was imprisoned in Nemata.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: Told Darigaaz the legend of the Primevals.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Place where Rith was imprisoned again by Magnigoth Treefolk.

entities.name: Magnigoth Treefolk
entities.description: Treefolk who awoke, tracked Rith to Urborg, and swallowed her.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Event during which Rith was freed again.

events.summary: During the Fall of the Primevals, Rith is imprisoned inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata by the green Numena.
events.quote: she was imprisoned inside the Magnigoth Treefolk Nemata in Yavimaya by the green Numena

events.summary: Rith is the first freed by Rhammidarigaaz after Tevesh Szat tells him of the Primevals; she dominates Darigaaz's mind to free all the primevals.
events.quote: she dominated Darigaaz's mind, convincing him to free all of the primevals regardless of the cost to mortal dragon lives

events.summary: Magnigoth Treefolk track Rith to Urborg, rip her from the sky and swallow her, returning to Yavimaya.
events.quote: The lead treefolk ripped her out of the sky and swallowed her before returning to Yavimaya.

events.summary: Rith is freed again during the second Phyrexian Invasion when her psychic connection to her reincarnated brother reawakens her.
events.quote: when her psychic connection to her reincarnated brother reawakened her

relations.quote: She is the daughter of Palladia-Mors and the sister of Darigaaz .
She is the daughter of Palladia-Mors
Rith is one of the five Primeval Dragons of Dominaria .
